description.describe_ch:
1.分析空間設計中關於材料所代表的價值－認識材料，還原材料本質。
2.藉由討論瞭解空間中材料所展現的文化意義－涵構意義。
3.建立學生培養生活中材料開發的創意及敏感度。
description.describe_eh:
1.	In the analysis space design the value－understanding material which represents about the material,the return to original state material essence.
2.	Because of the discussion understood in the space the material unfolds the cultural significance－contains the construction significance.
3.	Establishes the student to raise in the life the material development creativity and the sensitivity.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
學期成績
  • 成績相關規定
    • 期中、期末會依時間線上公佈成績。(Midterm and the final result will post on the school’s learning platform)
    • 期末須將學期指定成果上傳至雲端繳交，包含設計定案圖說及報告書等相關資料，未繳交者扣總分10分。(Specific coursework will be requested to upload onto an online platform. If a student fails to upload the requested file at the end of the semester, one whole letter grade drops)
  • 期中與期末成績
    • 期中與期末成績不及格時，一律不接受『補交與補考』。(If a student fails the midterm or the final, no make-up exam or equivalent will be issued)
    • 期中與期末考試請假『僅限』重大事故，須出示證明文件，並須在規定時間內提完成補考與補件給予分數。逾時視同放棄。(If a student missed the midterm or the final due to unforeseen events, only the university's acceptable excuses will be accepted. The student must provide the document promptly)
  • 本學期此課額外花費與注意事項:
    • 學期中『者』會有額外共同花費，包含移地教學交通車費用等相關花費。所有費用計算與收據會線上透明公開，並且由老師與學生一起平分。 如無參加移地教學的學生，不需要分擔共同花費，但會被扣分與失去繳交移地教學相關作業權利。(This course may have extra costs, including field trips and traveling expenses. A detailed cost breakdown and receipts will be posted on the school’s online learning platform. The final cost will be shared among teachers and students. No sharing cost will be necessary if a student can not attend the trip. However, this student will forgo the right to upload trip-related reports.)
 
  • 學期中移地教學『者』會有安全穿著規定，如果學生沒有達到安全穿著或現場檢查不合格者，一律不可進入移地教學場所。(Students must wear proper safety clothing and hardware during field trips. If one does not meet the safety standard, then one can not enter the visiting facility.)
 
  • 學期中參加移地教學者一律『須要』簽相關安全文件與投保相關意外險，檢查不合格者一律不可進入移地教學場所。(Students must sign proper safety documents before field trips. If one does not sign the safety standard, then one can not enter the visiting facility.)
 
  • 本學期此課出勤考核辦法如下:
    • 缺課：為充分考核同學之用功情形，本課程嚴格要求同學出席上課，每週於上課時間內定時點名，（至少一次），未到者一律以缺課論送教務處登記。曠課『合計總數』超過 6 次以上者，皆列入警告與不及格名單，若有特殊狀況（重病、家庭變故等）請提早告知老師並討論。(Attendance is required in this course. If one misses more than 6 classes during the semester, one will be issued a failing grade as a warning. If a student misses the class due to unforeseen events, only the university's acceptable excuses will be accepted. The student must provide the document promptly.)
    • 移地教學缺課: 未到者一律以缺課論送教務處登記，並且扣『總分』5分，若有特殊狀況（重病、家庭變故等）請提早告知老師並討論。(If a student misses the course field trips, each time will result in a 5 points deduction from the final grade. If a student misses the class due to unforeseen events, only the university's acceptable excuses will be accepted. The student must provide the document promptly.)
    • 移地教學脫隊: 未到者一律以缺課論送教務處登記，並且扣『總分』10分，若有特殊狀況（重病、家庭變故等）請提早告知老師並討論。(If a student attended the field trips but straggler during the visit, each time will result in a 10 points deduction from the final grade. If a student misses the class due to unforeseen events, only the university's acceptable excuses will be accepted. The student must provide the document promptly.)
  • 身心障礙協助
    • 如學生提供學校認可的身心障礙相關證明，本課會提供於身心障礙學生的協助。(This course will provide additional assistance to the needed student, provided to the student who has the university's acceptable document.)
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
上課時間上午10點10分準時開課到約上午11點50分時。提早10分鐘下課原因為上課時跳過1次10分鐘休息時間。(This course will start on time and provide a 10-minute break during halftime. The course will end 10 minutes early due to not having to take an additional break during class time.)

每次上課前後各組需清潔上課環境與衛生。(Keep the course environment clean, and do not leave any trash behind.)

行動電話上課時所有行動電話或是會打擾上課過程的電子產品必須一律調到靜音。(Turning all communication devices to mute or vibration.)

除非學生有特殊需求，一律禁止上課錄影、錄音、拍照。(No recording, voice recording, and photographic during the course time unless a request is made.)

若組TEAM WORK以2人一組為原則，由指導老師依題目情況自訂之。(Team is referring to 2 people unless the instructor says otherwise.)

電腦出圖規格:
請以電腦出圖模式貼版為原則，其他表現法時，須經指導老師同意。(All digital output must meet the instructor’s standard.)

上敘內容修訂或不足之處，由本課教師決定。(The course instructor maintains the right to update the course syllabus during the semester.)
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
This course will start on time and provide a 10-minute break during halftime. The course will end 10 minutes early due to not having to take an additional break during class time.

Keep the course environment clean, and do not leave any trash behind.

Turning all communication devices to mute or vibration.

No recording, voice recording, and photographic during the course time unless a request is made.

Team is referring to 2 people unless the instructor says otherwise.

All digital output must meet the instructor’s standard.

The course instructor maintains the right to update the course syllabus during the semester.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
1. 報告書內容超過30%與既有論文、網路文章等相關資訊來源，一律視為不及格。(If a student’s report content exceeds more than 30% plagiarized existing journal articles, online articles, or other resources, the student will fail that report assignment)
  2. 報告書內容超過30%透過ChatGPT等相關AI工具來源，一律視為不及格。(If a student’s report content exceeds more than 30% generated from ChatGPT or other AI tool resources, the student will fail that report assignment)
  3. 報告書內容若有AI生成文字、圖片與影片皆必須註明。(If a student’s report contains text, pictures, and video generated from AI tools, all material must be properly cited)
  4. 報告書內容超過5項引用，但是沒有註明，一律視為不及格。(If a student’s report content exceeds more than 5 references that are not correctly cited, the student will fail that report assignment)
  5. 考試作弊或是干擾考試秩序，一律視為不及格。(If a student cheats or disrupts an exam, the student will fail that exam)
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
1. If a student’s report content exceeds more than 30% plagiarized existing journal articles, online articles, or other resources, the student will fail that report assignment.
  2. If a student’s report content exceeds more than 30% generated from ChatGPT or other AI tool resources, the student will fail that report assignment)
  3. If a student’s report contains text, pictures, and video generated from AI tools, all material must be properly cited.
  4. If a student’s report content exceeds more than 5 references that are not correctly cited, the student will fail that report assignment.
  5. If a student cheats or disrupts an exam, the student will fail that exam.

    • 缺課：為充分考核同學之用功情形，本課程嚴格要求同學出席上課，每週於上課時間內定時點名，（至少一次），未到者一律以缺課論送教務處登記。曠課『合計總數』超過 6 次以上者，皆列入警告與不及格名單，若有特殊狀況（重病、家庭變故等）請提早告知老師並討論。(Attendance is required in this course. If one misses more than 6 classes during the semester, one will be issued a failing grade as a warning. If a student misses the class due to unforeseen events, only the university's acceptable excuses will be accepted. The student must provide the document promptly.)
    • 移地教學缺課: 未到者一律以缺課論送教務處登記，並且扣『總分』5分，若有特殊狀況（重病、家庭變故等）請提早告知老師並討論。(If a student misses the course field trips, each time will result in a 5 points deduction from the final grade. If a student misses the class due to unforeseen events, only the university's acceptable excuses will be accepted. The student must provide the document promptly.)
    • 移地教學脫隊: 未到者一律以缺課論送教務處登記，並且扣『總分』10分，若有特殊狀況（重病、家庭變故等）請提早告知老師並討論。(If a student attended the field trips but straggler during the visit, each time will result in a 10 points deduction from the final grade. If a student misses the class due to unforeseen events, only the university's acceptable excuses will be accepted. The student must provide the document promptly.)
  • 身心障礙協助
    • 如學生提供學校認可的身心障礙相關證明，本課會提供於身心障礙學生的協助。(This course will provide additional assistance to the needed student, provided to the student who has the university's acceptable document.)
policy.course_pol:
上課時間上午10點10分準時開課到約上午11點50分時。提早10分鐘下課原因為上課時跳過1次10分鐘休息時間。(This course will start on time and provide a 10-minute break during halftime. The course will end 10 minutes early due to not having to take an additional break during class time.)

每次上課前後各組需清潔上課環境與衛生。(Keep the course environment clean, and do not leave any trash behind.)

行動電話上課時所有行動電話或是會打擾上課過程的電子產品必須一律調到靜音。(Turning all communication devices to mute or vibration.)

除非學生有特殊需求，一律禁止上課錄影、錄音、拍照。(No recording, voice recording, and photographic during the course time unless a request is made.)

若組TEAM WORK以2人一組為原則，由指導老師依題目情況自訂之。(Team is referring to 2 people unless the instructor says otherwise.)

電腦出圖規格:
請以電腦出圖模式貼版為原則，其他表現法時，須經指導老師同意。(All digital output must meet the instructor’s standard.)

上敘內容修訂或不足之處，由本課教師決定。(The course instructor maintains the right to update the course syllabus during the semester.)

policy.ais_meno:
1. 報告書內容超過30%與既有論文、網路文章等相關資訊來源，一律視為不及格。(If a student’s report content exceeds more than 30% plagiarized existing journal articles, online articles, or other resources, the student will fail that report assignment)
  2. 報告書內容超過30%透過ChatGPT等相關AI工具來源，一律視為不及格。(If a student’s report content exceeds more than 30% generated from ChatGPT or other AI tool resources, the student will fail that report assignment)
  3. 報告書內容若有AI生成文字、圖片與影片皆必須註明。(If a student’s report contains text, pictures, and video generated from AI tools, all material must be properly cited)
  4. 報告書內容超過5項引用，但是沒有註明，一律視為不及格。(If a student’s report content exceeds more than 5 references that are not correctly cited, the student will fail that report assignment)
  5. 考試作弊或是干擾考試秩序，一律視為不及格。(If a student cheats or disrupts an exam, the student will fail that exam)
